violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026
Spray bottles used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the cafeteria, are not tight-fitting. Space observed between the 2 doors on each side of the cafeteria. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/09/2026

Utensils in the cafeteria observed displayed with the lip surface up. Utensils are to be stored so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self-service is provided. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/29/2026
Leaking observed at the 3-bay sink. Plumbing must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2026

The outside dumpster is not covered completely. One of the covers does not tightly fit the top. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept completely covered. New Violation. Correct By: 10/06/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the cafeteria, are not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 02/18/2026

2-door reach-in, located in the kitchen, is not in good repair. It is not currently being used. Service present during inspection to repair the unit. All TCS foods had been relocated to properly functioning refrigeration units. New Violation. Correct By: 02/06/2026

The doors to the outside, located in the cafeteria, are not tight-fitting. Space observed at the bottom between the doors. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2025

Thermometer is lacking in milk chest cooler #2 (back of cafeteria). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 02/28/2025
Spray bottle used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies was not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2024

The doors to the outside, located on the left side of the cafeteria, are not tight-fitting. Space observed at the bottom between the doors. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 11/03/2023
